metadata.method: Visual review of actual extracted frames at 10 fps end-to-end, wider context at0.5s/2s, focused10fps transition sheets. No audio-based control claims, no gameplay input telemetry, no animation edits.
caveats: Forward/backward/left/right are camera-space motion inferences from static-world scale/parallax; no keypresses are visible.
Higher/intermediate/ground are observed height bands; standing/crouch/prone are inferred game stances, not directly observed full-body pose.
ADS is directly supported by centered aligned ironsights; ADS FOV/perspective and camera motion prevent blindly converting2D displacement into 3D bones.
Exact bone transforms, true FOV, units-per-second, gait phase, animation names and transition input timing are not recoverable uniquely from footage.
No demonstrated jump/landing, firing/recoil or reload loop is selected.
Intermediate-height ADS is not clearly demonstrated in this clip; do not invent a crouched ADS source.
Direction transition frames have uncertainty; selected interior ranges are safer than segment boundaries.
Source footage and extracted frames are private analysis materials and were not published.
